{"task":"derive_control_dae","difficulty":"medium","control_units":["Frequency dead zone and droop","Combined power/frequency PI","Fixed transport delay","Reference-model lag and limiter","Adaptive-gain integrator and limiter","Gate-command product and limiter"],"inputs":["P_set","P","f_set","f"],"states":["x_PI","x_m","eta"],"outputs":["G_set"],"differential_equations":["d(x_PI)/dt = (K_p/T_i)*e","d(x_m)/dt = (e_del-x_m)/t_PFC","d(eta)/dt = Gamma*(y_m-DZ(e_f;d_lo,d_hi)/R)*y_m"],"algebraic_equations":["e_f = f_set - f","e = P_set - P + DZ(e_f;d_lo,d_hi)/R","u_PI = K_p*e + x_PI","e_del(t) = DZ(e_f(t-tau);d_lo,d_hi)/R","y_m = clip(x_m;ym_lo,ym_hi)","epsilon = y_m - DZ(e_f;d_lo,d_hi)/R","theta = clip(eta;theta_lo,theta_hi)","G_set = clip(theta*u_PI;g_lo,g_hi)"],"notes":"x_PI is the weighted PI integral output, x_m the reference-model lag state, and eta the adaptive-integrator state. r_f=DZ(e_f;d_lo,d_hi)/R is the frequency-droop signal; e_del is its delayed value. The selected delay is exact fixed transport with tau>=0: supply r_f history on [t0-tau,t0) as well as the three initial ODE coordinates. DZ(x;lo,hi)=x-lo below lo, zero on [lo,hi], and x-hi above hi, with d_lo<=0<=d_hi. clip(x;lo,hi)=min(hi,max(lo,x)); y_m, theta and G_set have ordered symbolic bounds. T_i,t_PFC>0, R!=0 and all coefficients are finite. Gamma is the signed adaptation gain. theta is clipped eta; output limiting leaves integral memories unrestricted."}

A partir del diagrama de bloques de control o equivalente de la imagen, proporciona anotaciones DAE para el modelado dinámico, incluidas las unidades de control, las entradas, los estados, las salidas, las ecuaciones diferenciales y las ecuaciones algebraicas.
annotations.ar:
<image>
استنادًا إلى مخطط كتل التحكم أو المخطط المكافئ في الصورة، قدّم توصيفًا بنظام المعادلات التفاضلية الجبرية (DAE) للنمذجة الديناميكية، يتضمن وحدات التحكم والمدخلات ومتغيرات الحالة والمخرجات والمعادلات التفاضلية والمعادلات الجبرية.
annotations.fr:
<image>
À partir du schéma fonctionnel de commande ou du schéma équivalent présenté dans l’image, fournissez des annotations DAE pour la modélisation dynamique, comprenant les unités de commande, les entrées, les états, les sorties, les équations différentielles et les équations algébriques.
annotations.ru:
<image>
На основе структурной схемы управления или эквивалентной схемы на изображении представьте аннотацию в форме дифференциально-алгебраических уравнений (DAE) для динамического моделирования, включая блоки управления, входы, состояния, выходы, дифференциальные и алгебраические уравнения.
